description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki Samurai Complete Door Refurbishment or upgrade conversion Kit for model year 1985 – 1995
Color: Black
Includes all the interior Door Handles, Handles Bezels, Pulls, Lock Rods, Window Cranks & Escutcheons plus the Window Regulators for BOTH DOORS.
We even includes the Installation Screws!(As Shown in Picture)
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Window Regulators
Qty 2 – Door Handles
Qty 2 – Handle Cases – w/installation screws
Qty 2 – Door Lock Posts, Rods & Grommets
Qty 2 – Window Cranks
Qty 2 – Window Crank Washers
Qty 2 – Door Pulls – w/installation screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
